001: Good morning! You're the new colleague who's starting today, right?
Good morning! Yes, that's me. My name is Rafael, nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, Rafael! I'm Fernanda. Make yourself at home, if you need anything just call me.
Thank you! I'm still a little lost, but I think I'll get used to it quickly.
That's normal on the first day. I'll show you the office and introduce you to the team.
Perfect, I really appreciate your patience.
002: Rafael, have you had the chance to talk to your direct manager yet?
Not yet, Fernanda. He was in a meeting when I arrived.
I see. He should come find you later today to go over the first tasks.
That's good. I feel more at ease knowing he's going to guide me.
You can be sure of that. Here, we usually give full support to people who are just starting out.
That makes me feel much more excited about the job.
003: Have you set up your computer and access to the internal system yet?
I haven't finished yet, I'm waiting for the IT team to release my password.
Oh, right. In the meantime, I can show you the folder with the company manuals.
That would be great! That way I can get a head start and learn the processes.
I'll send you the link by email right now.
I got it here, thank you so much! I'll start reading right away.
004: Rafael, do you eat lunch around here or do you prefer to bring your own lunch?
I don't know the restaurants in the area yet. What do you recommend?
There's a really good self-service place two blocks from here, and the price is fair.
Great tip! I'll try it today, if I have time.
If you want, we can go together. I usually leave at noon sharp.
It's a deal then! It'll be good for me to get familiar with the place.
005: Do you already know what your main responsibility will be in this first month?
From what they explained to me, I'll be working on customer support and organizing the reports.
That makes sense, the team needed help with that part.
I'm happy to be able to contribute from the start.
And if you have any questions about the procedures, feel free to ask without hesitation.
For sure, I'll write everything down so I don't get lost.
006: Rafael, do you know the company's work schedule policy?
I know the work hours are from nine to six, with an hour for lunch.
That's right. But we have flexibility to adjust the schedule if you need to.
That's great! It helps a lot with personal organization.
You just need to talk to your manager and register the change in the system.
Perfect, I'll plan things out properly and align it with him.
007: Have you been introduced to everyone in your department, or is there still someone you haven't met?
I met a few people, but I haven't talked to the finance team yet.
No problem, I'll take you there now so you can introduce yourself.
Thank you so much, Fernanda. You've been very kind to me.
Don't mention it, it's always nice to welcome new people. It's part of the culture here.
I noticed that right away, the atmosphere is very welcoming.
008: Rafael, have you thought about how you're going to organize your work routine?
I'm still adjusting, but I plan to use a task list to prioritize.
That's a good practice. I use a project management tool myself.
Could you show me how it works? I think it would help me a lot.
Sure, I'll show you as soon as my ten o'clock meeting is over.
Sounds good, I'll be waiting. Thanks for being available.
009: Do you know where the break room and the restroom are? If you need anything, just ask me.
They already showed me, but I admit I'm still finding my way around the building.
Don't worry, it's like that in the first week. Soon you'll be walking around here with your eyes closed.
I hope so! Especially since the building is quite big.
It is big, but once you get used to it, everything becomes very simple.
010: Rafael, to wrap up the day, did you manage to understand your first tasks well?
I think so. I already wrote down the deadlines and I know what I need to deliver by Friday.
Excellent! You're starting off really well, with great organization.
Thank you for your support today, it made all the difference for me.
I'm happy to help. We'll talk tomorrow and I'll support you with whatever you need.
Perfect, see you tomorrow then. Have a great night!
